tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description:
Search Vault developer and help documentation. Each result includes a `content_url` (rendered HTML) and a `markdown_url` (Markdown). Fetch `markdown_url` when results are incomplete or the task needs full context. SDK and VAPIL javadocs have no `markdown_url`.

## Sources

- `vault_developer_documentation`: Vault Developer Portal (Java SDK, API, MDL, VQL, Direct Data API, Custom Pages, Vault AI) and Vault CRM Developer Portal. Use vault_crm+limited for CRM.
- `vault_api_reference`: API endpoint reference — URIs, parameters, response attributes, error types. Use vault_crm+limited for CRM.
- `vault_java_sdk_javadocs`: Vault Java SDK javadocs — classes, methods, parameters, return types, exceptions.
- `vapil_javadocs`: VAPIL javadocs — classes, methods, code examples.
- `vault_help_documentation`: End-user and admin docs. Vault Help and Vault CRM Help. Use vault_crm+limited for CRM.

## Releases

Defaults to general. `vapil_javadocs` is general-only. Help, developer, and API sources with vault_crm are limited-only.

- `general`: ~every four months; includes all limited enhancements since prior general release.
- `limited`: ~every 3–5 weeks; early access to new features.

## App Families

Defaults to platform. Ask user if unclear for developer, API, and help sources. `vapil_javadocs` and `vault_java_sdk_javadocs` are platform-only. Always use release=limited with vault_crm.

- `platform`: Base Vault platform.
- `commercial`: PromoMats, Portal
- `qualityone`: Document Control, QMS, HACCP, HSE, Training
- `quality`: QualityDocs, Training, Station Manager, QMS, Surveillance, Validation Mgmt, Batch Release, HACCP
- `medical`: MedComms, Medical Inquiry, Portal
- `clinical`: CTMS, eTMF, Payments, SSU, Disclosures, Site Connect, OpenData Clinical
- `regulatory`: Submissions, Submissions Archive, Submissions Publishing, Registrations
- `safety`: Safety, Safety Workbench, Safety Signal, SafetyDocs

tools.name: search_release_notes
tools.description:
Search Veeva Vault release notes to find features, changes, and enhancements introduced in a specific release or range of releases.

Each result includes a `content_url` (rendered HTML) and a `markdown_url` (Markdown). Fetch `markdown_url` when the query asks for a complete feature list (e.g. "what's new in 26R2?") — search results cover only a subset. Also fetch when results share the same `markdown_url` or content is incomplete.

## Sources

- `vault_developer_release_notes`: Vault Developer Portal — Java SDK, API, VQL, MDL, Direct Data API, platform developer features.
- `vault_help_release_notes`: Vault Help site — platform and app-family features for end users and admins.
- `vault_crm_release_notes`: Vault CRM Help site.
- `vault_crm_developer_release_notes`: Vault CRM Developer Portal — X-Pages, X-Pages Studio, CRM REST API.

## Release Format

Major version only (e.g. `26R2`, `25R1`).

- `start_release`: Optional. Omit to search all releases.
- `end_release`: Optional upper bound (requires `start_release`). E.g. `start_release=24R1`, `end_release=26R2` searches that span.

### Point Release Mapping

Point releases (minor > 0, e.g. 26R2.1) deliver features for the *next* major release. Apply the same mapping to both `start_release` and `end_release`:

| User asks about  | Use release |
| ---------------- |-------------|
| 26R2.0 (GA)      | `26R2`      |
| 26R2.1 – 26R2.x  | `26R3`      |
| 26R1.1 – 26R1.x  | `26R2`      |
| 26R3.1 – 26R3.x  | `27R1`      |

GA (`.0`) uses its own release; any point release (`.1`+) uses the next release. This applies to both `start_release` and `end_release`.

source.description: The release note source to search. Available sources: vault_developer_release_notes, vault_help_release_notes, vault_crm_release_notes, vault_crm_developer_release_notes

start_release.description: Optional release version to search (e.g. '26R2'). Major version only. Omit to search across all releases for the given source.

end_release.description: Optional upper bound release version (same format as start_release). Only used when start_release is also provided.
